info.title: Job Referral core API contract — design only
info.description: Phase 1 design. No HTTP implementation is shipped in Phase 2.

get.description: Actor derived from JWT subject; accepted active discoverable connections only.
Live consent, blocks and current verified employment are checked; as_of is server controlled.
Self matching only; baseline scores are explanatory, not hiring probabilities.

post.description: Actor is inviter; normalize pair; reverse duplicate/conflict is 409.
Accept/reject only by invite recipient; block by endpoint; current revision required.
Accept/reject only by invite recipient; block by endpoint; current revision required.
Accept/reject only by invite recipient; block by endpoint; current revision required.

Candidate derived from JWT; validate open job, active current verified referrer and live accepted consent path. Atomic request/notification/audit. Same key+same body returns original with 200; same key+different body returns 409.

get.description: Only candidate or addressed referrer may read; recruiter access requires explicit application consent.

post.description: Referrer only; pending to accepted; revalidate job/employment.
Referrer only; pending to rejected.
Candidate only; pending/accepted to cancelled.
Referrer only; accepted to submitted; evidence required and live job/employment/path revalidation.
Referrer only; submitted to completed; record outcome in history.
Normalize email; derive default roles server side. No client role assignment. Hash password with Argon2id; no plaintext storage.
Generic credential error; configurable IP rate limit; active users only.
Validate refresh-token hash, rotate atomically; reject reuse and revoked sessions.
Revoke the owned session and its refresh-token chain.

patch.description: Owner only; normalize/validate salary_min<=salary_max and profile values; no roles/email/status mutation.

get.description: Apply discoverability and block policy; expose only permitted public fields.

post.description: Actor becomes verified owner only after company-management verification process; no claim from works_at alone.

patch.description: Verified company owner only; optimistic revision and audit.

get.description: Verified owner only; not public employee listing.

post.description: Verified owner only; verify appointment before verified=true; audit; bounded unique member user_id.

get.description: Public open jobs; unpublished jobs only for verified company members.

post.description: Admin taxonomy scope; canonical name unique; audit required.

patch.description: Admin taxonomy scope; no hard deletion of referenced skills.

get.description: Public open jobs with stable recency/ID sorting.

post.description: Verified owner/recruiter of company; salary bounds; transaction job/company/requirements; all skill endpoints must exist.

patch.description: Verified company owner/recruiter; no company reassignment after workflow records exist; transaction requirements update.

post.description: Verified company owner/recruiter; idempotent close; keep applications/referral history.

get.description: Actor is invitation recipient; pending only.

delete.description: Endpoint owner only; soft delete; blocked records require explicit unblock before deletion.

post.description: Candidate derived from auth; open job; unique candidate/job; owned resume and consent checked; transactional audit.

get.description: Candidate or verified employer recruiter with explicit consent; no global admin CV bypass.

patch.description: Verified company recruiter with consent; valid state transition and audit.

post.description: Candidate only; nonterminal to withdrawn; history retained.

get.description: Recipient only; no private message/CV/path payload.

post.description: Recipient only; idempotently set read_at.

patch.description: Scoped admin moderation; audit; no arbitrary access to private profile/CV.
